main_text.p: modo particula admirandi, Rom.11.33. increpandi, Luc.24.25.
᾿Ωδὲ hic, Adv. Coloss.4.9. τὰ ὧδε scil. οὖσα, quae hic geruntur. Item huc Apoc.4.1. Luc.23.5. ἕως ὧδε huc usque.
᾿Ωδὴ ἧς ἡ cantus per crasin, pro ᾠδὴ ἧς ἡ cantus: a prat.med. ᾄδω verbi ᾄδω cano.
᾿Ωδὶν ᾠδίνων ἡ proprie dolor parturientis, 1. Thess.5.3. item per synecd.spec. dolor quivis. Actor.2.24. affine hoc nomen Themati ὠδὶν ης ἡ dolor.
᾿Ωδίνω parturio, Gal.4.19. F. ὠδίνω Habac.3.9. & ὠδινήσω. a.1. ὠδίνησα Psalm.7.15. a.2.act. ὠδίνον εις ε Esa.23.4. P. ὠδίνηκα.
᾿Ωνέομαι ἐωμαι emo, mercor. Fut. med. ὠνήσομαι. Praet.pass. ὠνήμαι. aor.1.med. ὠνησάμην ὡ ὠνο emi.

᾿Ωρα ὡς ἡ hora Joh.4.52. per synecd.spec. tempus 1.Johan.2.18. Philem.v.15. τῆς ὥρας ad tempus per synecd. membri dies Marc.6.35. per synecd. integr. momentum Luc.12.12. per syn. memb. & integri tertius diei quadrans Marc.15.25.
᾿Ωραῖος ὠραῖον speciosus a um. ab ὥρα ὡς ἡ pulcritudo, Rom.10.15.
᾿Ωρύω rugio. Fut.ύσω. P. ὠρυγμαι. aor.1.ὠρυσα. Praes. med. ὠρύομαι rugio.

page.notes: Right-hand marginal notes (cut off at the gutter and partly on the facing page) are too fragmentary and overlapping to be read reliably; they are not transcribed. Greek accents and breathings in the main text are uncertain in places. Heavy gutter shadow on the right edge of the page.
